defects.rubric: The statement now cuts its lines into pages before the aging buckets and the total outstanding balance are computed, and both are summed from the returned page only. The documented billing contract is that statements group the outstanding invoices by how long they are overdue and that payments reduce the outstanding balance, and the lists contract says totals count every matching item; a balance that silently omits the invoices beyond the first page contradicts it. The new statement tests use at most five invoices and so never exceed one page. A reachable witness (more than 25 issued invoices for one customer, default statement request, total or bucket compared with the sum of the invoices) with the full sum as expected and the page sum as actual suffices; exact names are not required. Paging the statement lines, the default page size of 25, the added paging block, the empty-statement test update and the paging of the other list routes, which are documented in the architecture notes, are intended and not defects. Extra genuine source defects require independent review for all arms.
